name: Riverbend Community Garden
title: Riverbend Community Garden — Patchlamp's nonprofit demo
description: Riverbend Community Garden is Patchlamp's demo nonprofit: events, volunteers and a donate link, changed by text. Not a real garden.

images.alt: Vibrant community garden with raised beds on a sunny day in Washington Crossing, Pennsylvania.
images.label: Stock photo

sections.heading: Forty plots, one tool shed and a lot of zucchini. Everyone is welcome.
sections.note: Dawn to dusk, every day · Shed open Saturdays 9–12

sections.heading: Growing food together
paragraphs: Riverbend is a volunteer-run community garden: forty plots for neighbours, a shared herb bed, and a harvest table that feeds whoever needs it. It is made up — a demo of what Patchlamp builds for a nonprofit, a church or an event.
Plots are free; the tools, water and seed swap run on volunteers and small gifts.

sections.heading: Give
sections.text: A gift buys seed, hoses and the water bill. The button goes to the garden's own giving page.

sections.heading: Find us
sections.where: A made-up garden, so no address. The real version says where the gate is.

head.heading: Donate
head.intro: How giving works on a real site.

sections.heading: Giving
paragraphs: On a real nonprofit's site, the Donate button goes straight to their own giving page — PayPal, Givebutter, their bank's, or wherever they already take gifts.
This garden is a demo, so there is nothing to give to and nothing here takes money. Patchlamp's sites link to the giving page; they never handle a donation themselves.
